name: Müllerthal and Upper Sûre forests
story: The Mullerthal region is located in the east of Luxembourg and is dominated by craggy terrain, thick forests, caves, and small streams. The Upper Sûre Lake is a large reservoir in north-western Luxembourg created by the Esch-sur-Sûre Dam built in the 1950s.
matters: The region around the reservoir forms the Upper Sûre Natural Park, and the surrounding valley has been designated as a Ramsar site since 2004. The lake has a very high level of water quality.
